name: NPC Teleporter
description: Teleporter NPCs in capitals (entry 190000) and starting zones (190001).

sql.statement: START TRANSACTION; SET @tp_cap:=IFNULL((SELECT gossip_menu_id FROM creature_template WHERE entry=190000),0); SET @tp_zone:=IFNULL((SELECT gossip_menu_id FROM creature_template WHERE entry=190001),0); DELETE FROM gossip_menu_option WHERE @tp_cap+@tp_zone>0 AND MenuID IN (SELECT MenuID FROM gossip_menu WHERE TextID BETWEEN 300000 AND 300009 AND (MenuID BETWEEN @tp_cap AND @tp_cap+9 OR MenuID=@tp_zone)); DELETE FROM conditions WHERE @tp_cap+@tp_zone>0 AND SourceTypeOrReferenceId IN (14,15) AND SourceGroup IN (SELECT MenuID FROM gossip_menu WHERE TextID BETWEEN 300000 AND 300009 AND (MenuID BETWEEN @tp_cap AND @tp_cap+9 OR MenuID=@tp_zone)); DELETE FROM gossip_menu WHERE @tp_cap+@tp_zone>0 AND TextID BETWEEN 300000 AND 300009 AND (MenuID BETWEEN @tp_cap AND @tp_cap+9 OR MenuID=@tp_zone); COMMIT;
sql.note: T564/T634: before the files run, clear the menus an earlier Install of THIS module made, found through the two NPCs' gossip_menu_id and kept to rows that carry the module's own npc_text ids (300000..300009), so a menu a user put in the same ids (or hand-edited to another text) is spared. Upstream's own DELETE only covers the ids it uses now, and an earlier Install may have put them elsewhere (50000.. before T564, 60000..60010 after it; upstream has used 60000-60018 since 38078d1d). A first Install finds no NPC and deletes nothing. Pinned by tests/test_npc_teleporter_menus.py. One transaction: a connection that dies in the middle leaves the world as it was.
upstream sets @ONY_LEVEL := 60 at line 18 and uses it in one row (line 189); the Onyxia step further down writes the answer into that row, so the clone stays unmodified

sql.statement: SET @tp_menu:=(SELECT gossip_menu_id FROM creature_template WHERE entry=190000); UPDATE conditions SET ConditionValue1={ony_level} WHERE SourceTypeOrReferenceId=15 AND SourceGroup=@tp_menu+4 AND SourceEntry=11 AND ConditionTypeOrReference=27;
sql.note: T104: the Onyxia portal's level requirement, the one row teleporter_capital.dist builds from @ONY_LEVEL (upstream @06e5242: `(15, @GOSSIP_MENU+4, 11, 27, @ONY_LEVEL, 3, 0, ...)`); T564: its group is the capital NPC's menu + 4 wherever the menus are (60004 since upstream 38078d1d), read from creature_template.gossip_menu_id

sql.statement: START TRANSACTION; SET @tp_cap:=IFNULL((SELECT gossip_menu_id FROM creature_template WHERE entry=190000),0); SET @tp_zone:=IFNULL((SELECT gossip_menu_id FROM creature_template WHERE entry=190001),0); DELETE FROM gossip_menu_option WHERE @tp_cap+@tp_zone>0 AND MenuID IN (SELECT MenuID FROM gossip_menu WHERE TextID BETWEEN 300000 AND 300009 AND (MenuID BETWEEN @tp_cap AND @tp_cap+9 OR MenuID=@tp_zone)); DELETE FROM conditions WHERE @tp_cap+@tp_zone>0 AND SourceTypeOrReferenceId IN (14,15) AND SourceGroup IN (SELECT MenuID FROM gossip_menu WHERE TextID BETWEEN 300000 AND 300009 AND (MenuID BETWEEN @tp_cap AND @tp_cap+9 OR MenuID=@tp_zone)); DELETE FROM gossip_menu WHERE @tp_cap+@tp_zone>0 AND TextID BETWEEN 300000 AND 300009 AND (MenuID BETWEEN @tp_cap AND @tp_cap+9 OR MenuID=@tp_zone); DELETE FROM creature WHERE id IN (190000,190001); DELETE FROM creature_template WHERE entry IN (190000,190001); DELETE FROM creature_template_model WHERE CreatureID IN (190000,190001); DELETE FROM creature_template_addon WHERE entry IN (190000,190001); DELETE FROM npc_text WHERE ID BETWEEN 300000 AND 300009; DELETE FROM smart_scripts WHERE entryorguid IN (190000,190001) AND source_type = 0; DELETE FROM gameobject WHERE id = 194394 AND guid >= 200000; COMMIT;
sql.note: T558: `creature.id`, not `id1`: AzerothCore's 2026_06_16_00.sql renamed id1 to id and dropped id2/id3, and every WotLK pin Yu'lon has shipped carries it (tests/test_wotlk_world_columns.py); T560: also the rows the two .dist files DELETE before they INSERT (their @GOSSIP_MENU 50000..50009 and 50009..50017, @TEXT_ID 300000..300005 and 300005..300009, the capital file's rune gameobject 194394 from guid 200000), tests/test_npc_teleporter_remove.py; T564: the menus of this module wherever it put them, found through the two NPCs' gossip_menu_id read before the NPCs are deleted (50000.. from an Install before T564, 60000..60010 from one after it, or what a later upstream uses), never by an id range, which may hold somebody else's menus; the base rows an old Install deleted are put back by the step after this one. The fixed 50000..50017 delete T560 had is gone for the same reason. The install transaction rolls back if the connection dies in the middle
